contact.basis: Fixed western cathedral entrance approach before terrain acquisition; exact thresholds/footings/host attachment remain approximate.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in native cathedral west-to-east frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; exact threshold/wall foot classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
